title: Lead Them, My God, to Thee

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [C]But from temptation's power, [F/C]Lead [C7/E]them, my God, [Bb/F]to Thee,
[C7/G]Lead them, [F]my God, to Thee, [C]Lead them to Thee.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [C7]And in [F]this world of sin Lived undefiled.
[C]O, for His sake, I [F/C]pray, Lead them, [C7/E]my God, [Bb/F]to Thee,
[C7/G]Lead them, [F]my God, to Thee, [C]Lead them to Thee.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [F]Yea, though my faith be [Bb]dim, I would [Gm/Bb]believe
[C7]That Thou [F]this precious gift Wilt now receive;
[C]O take their young hearts [F/C]now, Lead them [C7/E]my God [Bb/F]to Thee,
[C7/G]Lead them, [F]my God, to Thee, [C]Lead them to Thee.
